notes.title: New Creature - Stingray
notes.notes: [p]The Stingray's skill will be Venomous Spine. Indeed, this was previously the Manta Ray's skill.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526954/15e43e994452a0287755a9a1752780d63aad1dfd.png"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, the Manta Ray's skill has been redesigned.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526954/07c813b3d08bff7a116b24541d0ede5dafc4db72.png"][/img][/p][p]Players can experience these changes in the game.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Command Panel Updated
notes.notes:
The Command Panel has been updated. It is now possible to issue commands to individual units.
Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between command targets.
The Octopus's skin has been updated.

notes.title: New Creature: Octopus
notes.notes: [p]The octopus is a creature that can walk on land, albeit somewhat slowly. It can also move through the ocean. When close to the seabed, the octopus will automatically switch to walking mode. By pressing the jump button, you can switch to swimming mode while in the ocean.[/p][p align="start"]The octopus's skill is Entangle, which players can experience in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526954/811a8bcc21baa9cbf95355e6c4db741a80e5ef6e.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Additionally, various bugs have been fixed in this update. There are too many to list individually, and frankly, I can't recall them all.[/p]

notes.title: Updated the mod's API and added the new TigerShark skin.
notes.notes: Updating the mod's API will cause older mods to become incompatible. If a mod developer has already used the mod package to create mods, they simply need to pull the latest mod package and recompile the mod.

notes.title: Fix for Corrupted Saves & Added Backup to Prevent Save Issues
notes.notes:
Recently, we discovered that sudden power outages on computers could occasionally cause save files to become corrupted, preventing the game from being played. To address this, we have released an urgent fix.
Additionally, a backup mechanism has been implemented to minimize the chances of save file corruption.

notes.title: August 25 Update (New Mob: Sea Otter)
notes.notes:
[p]New Mob: Sea Otter — This is the first creature in the game that can both swim in water and crawl on land. The developer has put considerable effort into implementing this feature, which also allows greater flexibility for adding new mobs in the future.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526954/fb91492f769386ffff44e4987093d6fc40ff3662.png"][/img][/p][p]Other minor updates:

Hammerhead Shark's ability has been nerfed.
Great White Shark and Tuna's abilities have been buffed.
Some bugs have been fixed.[/p]
